document.name: West Side YMCA — Traditional Summer Camp (2026)
document.shortDescription: West Side YMCA runs weekday two-week summer camp sessions near Columbus Circle with traditional, early-childhood, kinder, and swim tracks for children ages 3 through 12.
document.longDescription:
The West Side YMCA publishes 2026 summer camp at 5 West 63rd Street on the Upper West Side, with camp dates from June 29 through August 21, 2026 in two-week sessions. The official page lists camp hours as 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. and an extended day option from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m., which supports weekday morning, afternoon, and after-school tags.

The same page lists Traditional Summer Camp for ages 6-12, Early Childhood Camp for ages 3-4, Kinder Camp for ages 4-5, and Swim Camp for ages 7-12. Published descriptions highlight physical fitness, arts and crafts, science activities, group play, and instructional swim.

Published community tuition for one two-week Traditional Summer Camp session is $1,135; Early Childhood and Kinder Camp are listed at $1,405 community, and Swim Camp at $1,500 community. Camp leadership contact on the official page is Donesha Bowden at wsycamp@ymcanyc.org and 212-912-2640.

Sources: https://ymcanyc.org/locations/west-side-ymca/programs-and-classes/camps https://ymcanyc.org/locations/west-side-ymca https://ymcanyc.org/sites/default/files/styles/hero_banner_desktop/public/2025-12/2026_camp_parachute.jpg.webp?itok=bMj91pWm
document.announcementDescription: The official page lists four two-week sessions from June 29 through August 21, 2026, with open house dates in April, May, and June.
